intent: Horizontal tab strip with an underline indicator. Two recipes share the .tabs/.tab skin: a plain link strip (<ul class="tabs"><li><a class="tab active">) where YOU wire the switching, and the zero-JS .tabset subcomponent that switches panes with hidden radio inputs and :has().

structure.description: The tab items. In the link recipe: <li><a class="tab"> with .active on the current one (.disabled to disable). In the tabset recipe: <label class="tab"> immediately following its radio input.

allowedIn: .tabset (as the strip of a CSS-only tabset)

a11yNotes: The link recipe carries no tab semantics by itself — add role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel" and aria-selected if you script it. The .tabset recipe rides on radio semantics instead: focus the group and switch with arrow keys; do not also add ARIA tab roles on top of the radios.

subcomponents.intent: CSS-only switching tabs: hidden radio inputs inside .tabs drive which .tab-pane is visible via :has() — no JavaScript. Supports at most 8 tabs (the :has()/:nth pane-matching rules are generated for indices 1-8).

structure.description: The strip. Its children must be alternating pairs: <input type="radio"> immediately followed by its <label class="tab"> (the CSS selects input:checked + .tab). All radios share one name; each label's for matches its input's id; exactly one input carries checked.

Visually-hidden radios as DIRECT children of .tabs. CRITICAL ordering constraint: the Nth radio (input:nth-of-type(N)) shows the Nth pane (.tab-pane:nth-child(N)) — radio order and pane order must correspond exactly.
Each label must be the immediate next sibling of its radio, and its for attribute must reference that radio's id.
Wrapper whose element children are ONLY .tab-pane divs, in the same order as the radios (pane visibility is matched by :nth-child, so any extra child element breaks the correspondence).
One pane per tab, direct children of .tab-panes, same count and order as the radios.

subcomponents.a11yNotes: Keyboard support comes from native radio groups (arrow keys switch, which also switches panes); the focused radio shows a focus ring on its label. Give the radio group a unique name per tabset on the page. Panes are display:none when inactive, so hidden content is correctly removed from the accessibility tree.
